audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1, 4-5 and 6 rendered as Skill and 2+ items as Quinn, while the whys under them say Quinn owns level 1 outright, converts at 4-5, has the roam tempo at 6, and that Sylas outscales at two items.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Quinn x6, Sylas] and matches the prose exactly; Quinn wins 54.87% over 842 games — the largest sample in this slice.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3 and 4 to Quinn and row 6 to Sylas, proposed as one atomic group across both layers, with phases[6].why rewritten to match its new side.

audit.why: Quinn levels 1-3, level 6 as roam tempo rather than burst, first-item lethality, Sylas at two AP items — right and ordered, and spikes[1] correctly refuses to sell Behind Enemy Lines as a duel button. Rank-1 numbers now attached.
audit.corrected: Abscond 13s / 400 range and Kingslayer 12s written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page invents a stun on Sylas's E. 'His dash + stun (recast pull)', 'his E chain-dash stun', 'dodge his E stun' — Abscond has no crowd control at all. Second error: the blind is credited with stopping 'his Q/W drain damage'. Chain Lash and Kingslayer are abilities; a blind cannot touch them. What the blind DOES deny is Petricite Burst, whose bonus magic damage rides on his basic attacks.
audit.why: Riot text for E: 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits' — no stun, and the kit file carries no hardCC flag on it. Riot text for the passive: 'Sylas's basic attacks will expend a charge and whirl his energized chains around him dealing bonus magic damage.'
audit.corrected: Stun removed from breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[0]; blind re-scoped to Petricite Burst autos in whys[1] and wants.you[0], with an explicit note that Chain Lash still lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked cooldown was described as a stun to bait; without the stun, the reason to track it changes — Abscond is how he closes 400 units, and Kingslayer (12s at rank 1) is what makes an extended trade go his way.
audit.why: A player told to 'bait the stun' will hold Vault for CC that never comes and then have no dash when he actually closes.
audit.corrected: Both cooldowns given with numbers and the correct role for each.

audit.why: report[8].t already buys early anti-heal, which the missing-interactions file confirms is the deciding item — Kingslayer heals him against champions, and it is the only heal in his kit.

edits.before: Passive-mark AA trades win every short exchange. Identify how Sylas contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Your range and Harrier resets beat a melee Sylas with no Abscond yet — step up and take the first exchange for free.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Sylas carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Kingslayer heals through your poke and Abduct pins you. Sylas carry threat 8.5/10 — close before this window.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Abscond (E): 13s at rank 1, 400 range — it dashes and the recast Abduct pulls him to you. It does not stun, so you are never locked down; you are just closed on. - Kingslayer (W, 12s) is the heal — anti-heal beats it.

edits.before: Track Sylas's Abscond / Abduct: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. When it is down — Blind + vault re-kite.
edits.after: Abduct pulls, it does not stun — Vault out after it lands. Blinding Assault denies his Petricite Burst auto procs.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Abscond is a dash and the Abduct recast pulls him onto you — no stun in it, only the gap close.

edits.before: W steroid online: your attack speed plus Q blind shuts off his Q/W drain damage in every trade.
edits.after: W steroid online: your attack speed plus the blind on his Petricite Burst autos wins every short trade.

edits.before: Land Q blind on his approach so his Q/W auto and drain damage whiffs while you Harrier-trade
edits.after: Blind him as he steps in so his Petricite Burst autos whiff — his Chain Lash still lands, keep moving

edits.before: Use E Vault to dodge his E chain-dash stun and reset Harrier for a free burst auto
edits.after: Vault away after he spends Abduct — the pull has no stun, so your dash still works

edits.before: Land his E chain-dash stun to pin you down so your kite range and Harrier resets do not matter
edits.after: Recast Abduct to chain himself onto you so Kingslayer and his autos land at melee range

notes: The invented stun on Abscond was the serious defect here — it told the player to hold Vault for CC that does not exist. It survives in the early and mid paragraphs ('his E chain-dash stun', 'Vaulting out of his stun') and in the generated focus label 'Sylas Abscond / Abduct', which is what seeded it; those need a follow-up pass. Note that Hijack (R) means his ultimate in this lane is usually YOUR Behind Enemy Lines or a teammate's — nothing on the page tells the player their own R can be stolen and used against their team, which is worth a dedicated line if space is ever freed up.
